# Inventory Allocation Simulator

Inventory Allocation Simulator is a multi-tenant supply-chain planning app for deciding where scarce inventory should sit before demand arrives.

## Architecture
Julia 1.11, Genie.jl, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, DuckDB, JuMP/HiGHS, server-rendered HTMX/Tailwind.

## API Surface
Tenant, warehouse, SKU, inventory, demand-history, imports, lanes, policies, simulations, recommendations, users, settings, notifications, integrations, health, readiness, and metrics endpoints are defined in `docs/inventory-allocation-simulator_prd.md` §8b.

## Integrations
Optional Delivery Tracking Gateway, Event-Driven Notification Hub, and Workflow Automation Engine. CSV import/export is required and standalone.

## Install
`julia --project -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'`

## Develop
`docker compose up -d postgres redis` then `julia --project src/Main.jl`.

## Test
`julia --project -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.test()'`
